issue.title: Bug: run_tests.sh failed with "Prepare DUT failed, skip testing" on pytest 9.0.2

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

With base of docker-sonic-mgmt upgrade to Ubuntu 24.04, pytest was upgraded from 7.4.0 to 9.0.2.
If we run the test in sonic-mgmt container with following command without specifying -u:
```shell
sudo ./run_tests.sh -n ardut -x -c bgp/test_bgp_suppress_fib.py
```
Then the following error blocks the test
```log
+ python3 -m pytest --inventory /data/ansible/lab,/data/ansible/veos --host-pattern ldp404 --dpu-pattern None --testbed ardut --testbed_file /data/ansible/testbed.yaml --log-cli-level warning --log-file-level debug --kube_master unset --showlocals --assert plain --show-capture no -rav -c /data/tests/pytest.ini --allow_recover --ignore=ptftests --ignore=acstests --ignore=saitests --ignore=scripts --ignore=k8s --ignore=sai_qualify --junit-xml=logs/pretest.xml --log-file=logs/pretest.log --topology util -m pretest
ERROR: usage: __main__.py [options] [file_or_dir] [file_or_dir] [...]
__main__.py: error: unrecognized arguments: --dpu-pattern --testbed ardut --testbed_file /data/ansible/testbed.yaml --kube_master unset --allow_recover --topology util
  inifile: /data/tests/pytest.ini
  rootdir: /data/tests

+ RESULT=4
+ [[ 4 != 0 ]]
+ echo '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
+ echo '!!!!!  Prepare DUT failed, skip testing  !!!!!'
!!!!!  Prepare DUT failed, skip testing  !!!!!
+ echo '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
+ exit 65
```

We found that the following functions don't specify a test path in run_tests.sh:
```shell
function prepare_dut()
{
    echo "=== Preparing DUT for subsequent tests ==="
    echo Running: ${PYTEST_EXEC} ${PYTEST_UTIL_OPTS} ${PRET_LOGGING_OPTIONS} ${UTIL_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS} $(pre_post_extra_params) -m pretest
    ${PYTEST_EXEC} ${PYTEST_UTIL_OPTS} ${PRET_LOGGING_OPTIONS} ${UTIL_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS} $(pre_post_extra_params) -m pretest
}

function cleanup_dut()
{
    echo "=== Cleaning up DUT after tests ==="
    echo Running: ${PYTEST_EXEC} ${PYTEST_UTIL_OPTS} ${POST_LOGGING_OPTIONS} ${UTIL_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS} $(pre_post_extra_params) -m posttest
    ${PYTEST_EXEC} ${PYTEST_UTIL_OPTS} ${POST_LOGGING_OPTIONS} ${UTIL_TOPOLOGY_OPTIONS} $(pre_post_extra_params) -m posttest
}
function run_bsl_tests()
{
    echo "=== Running BSL tests ==="
    echo Running: python3 -m pytest ${PYTEST_COMMON_OPTS} --skip_sanity --disable_loganalyzer --junit-xml=logs/bsl.xml --log-file logs/bsl.log -m bsl
    python3 -m pytest ${PYTEST_COMMON_OPTS} --skip_sanity --disable_loganalyzer --junit-xml=logs/bsl.xml --log-file logs/bsl.log -m bsl
}
```
It seems that it is a known pytest 9 issue in pytest community:
https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/13913

### Steps to Reproduce

Run run_test.sh without -u option which will run into prepare_dut() and cleanup_dut(), or run with -B for bsl tests.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

We shouldn't get the error.

resolution.title: Fix run_tests.sh "Prepare DUT failed, skip testing" failure on pytest 9.0.2
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Add explicit test path ${SCRIPT_PATH} to pytest commands that doesn't have it (pretest, posttest, bsl).
With new pytest 9.0.2, without an explicit test path, it fails to properly determine rootdir and load conftest.py, causing unrecognized arguments error.
Known issue in pytest repo:
https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/13913
Fixes #22508
